description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the SearchQuery class in the SuiteCRM project. It tests various methods of the SearchQuery class such as fromString, isEmpty, trim, toLowerCase, replace, stripSlashes, escapeRegex, convertEncoding, as well as methods for creating queries from request arrays and GET parameters.

classes.name: SearchQueryTest
classes.description: Test class for SearchQuery, extending SearchTestAbstract and containing various unit tests for SearchQuery methods.

methods.name: testFromString
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery from a string and checks the stored values.

methods.name: testIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests the isEmpty method on non-empty and empty queries.

methods.name: testTrim
methods.description: Tests the trim method which trims whitespace from the search string.

methods.name: testToLowerCase
methods.description: Tests converting the search string to lowercase.

methods.name: testReplace
methods.description: Tests replacing characters in the search string.

methods.name: testStripSlashes
methods.description: Tests stripping slashes from the search string.

methods.name: testEscapeRegex
methods.description: Tests escaping regex special characters in the search string.

methods.name: testConvertEncoding
methods.description: Tests converting HTML entities to UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: testFromRequestArray
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery from an array mimicking a request.

methods.name: testFromRequestArray2
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery with specific parameters from an array.

methods.name: testFromGetRequest
methods.description: Tests creating a SearchQuery from the global $_GET variable.
